result.explanation: Maintain the current clock and queued jobs. Before each event, discard expired jobs; advancing also discards jobs after increasing the clock. Accepted jobs consume capacity, cancellation and execution release their sizes, and execution selects earliest deadline then insertion order.
result.mapping: config.capacity maps to maximum queued bytes; state.now maps to time; state.jobs stores id, size, deadline, and insertion order; output.pending and output.bytes summarize queued jobs; output.ran identifies only a job executed by run.
result.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the stated event and numeric validity constraints. JSON state is private to this implementation and is returned unchanged in meaning between calls.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;let c=input.config.capacity,n=0,j=[],t=0;function x(){j=j.filter(q=>q.d>t)}for(let k=0;k<output.length;k++){let e=input.events[k],o=output[k];x();let r=null,s='';if(e.type==='add'){if(j.some(q=>q.id===e.id)||n+e.size>c||e.deadline<=t)s='rejected';else{s='accepted';j.push({id:e.id,size:e.size,d:e.deadline,ix:k});n+=e.size}}else if(e.type==='cancel'){let z=j.findIndex(q=>q.id===e.id);if(z<0)s='missing';else{s='cancelled';n-=j[z].size;j.splice(z,1)}}else if(e.type==='advance'){s='advanced';t+=e.dt;x()}else{s='empty';if(j.length){let z=0;for(let i=1;i<j.length;i++)if(j[i].d<j[z].d||j[i].d===j[z].d&&j[i].ix<j[z].ix)z=i;r=j[z].id;n-=j[z].size;j.splice(z,1);s='ran'}}if(o.status!==s||o.now!==t||o.bytes!==n||o.ran!==r||o.pending.length!==j.length) return false;for(let i=0;i<j.length;i++)if(o.pending[i]!==j[i].id)return false}return true}
